provenance.method: assumed from the DAS recordings; no camera's intrinsics: a recording without camera_info needs an uploaded calibration with intrinsics_fallback

pose_frame.method: the VIO body (x forward, y left, z up) at the IMU

body_to_optical.method: the pictures' own motion against the VIO poses, 24 axis-aligned rotations (1.1 deg)

T_camera_tcp.method: the fingertips in one frame and the widest opening

opening.method: the magnetic encoder reads metres (0-0.103 m on the recordings)
